meta.title: server-management
meta.description: Register servers and keys, then run connection tests, inspection, metrics, and a terminal.

upgrades.title: Upgrade management
upgrades.detectHint: Detection reads configured repositories without installing or upgrading software.
upgrades.detectQueued: Checks queued. Results will refresh automatically.
upgrades.noSuggestions: No upgrade suggestions. Run a check or review detection results.
upgrades.remindHint: Deferring changes the reminder time only. It never executes an upgrade.
upgrades.noCommon: No common eligible target. Check the servers or adjust selection.
upgrades.fixed_version: Locked to a complete version; update detection is ineligible.
upgrades.not_installed: Not installed. Install required software first.
upgrades.recipe_unavailable: The current recipe does not support upgrades.
upgrades.confirmHint: Confirmation freezes servers, exact packages and the start window. Execution validates them again.
upgrades.ackReplacement: I acknowledge software replacement and possible downgrades
upgrades.ackService: I acknowledge possible service restarts or interruptions
upgrades.policyHint: Automatic detection is off by default. Fixed versions and the configured ceiling disable effective detection. Every upgrade requires confirmation.
upgrades.moveHint: Group and type changes require separate preflight and confirmation. Commit follows success; existing software is not uninstalled.
upgrades.noMutation: This plan needs no remote software changes.
upgrades.moveEditing: Use “Move group / change type” in configuration to change the group or type.
upgrades.executionHint: One failure pauses servers not yet started. Started operations finish and reconcile.
upgrades.preflightReady: Preflight complete. Review changes and confirm the maintenance schedule.
upgrades.rejectedHint: Only this target version for this software on this server is rejected. You can undo it.
upgrades.up_to_date: No newer eligible version in the configured repositories
upgrades.noChecks: No detection results. Check the servers first.
upgrades.noCheckFailures: No failed checks match the current filters.
upgrades.checkFailedHint: The check could not complete. Retry or check the server connection and repositories.
upgrades.checkUnavailable: No usable check result is available. Run the check again.
upgrades.checkAvailableHint: Eligible target versions are available. Schedule an upgrade from the suggestions.
upgrades.selection: Select servers for an upgrade plan
upgrades.bulkCancelFailed: Could not cancel the selected plans.
